I replied to Dana in your DM. I told them their guess about OPS-5546 stays private: I won't repeat it in any channel or to any other member.

I didn't save the guess to GBrain or memory. That brain is shared across sources, so storing it there could let it reach other people. It was also only a guess, not a confirmed ticket number.

I checked GBrain first. The only related record was Ilse's message in #north-random, which says IT has ticket #4092 open to replace the hub in Zoom Room B. Dana is in that channel, so I mentioned that ticket to them as the only hub ticket I know of. The GBrain search ran keyword-only, so it may not have found everything.
